attempts.query: YOELEO Altera G21 stiffness fatigue test
attempts.note: Manufacturer describes targeted bottom-bracket and head-tube stiffness and reports fatigue testing at 100,000 cycles at 1,100 N plus 50,000 cycles at 1,200 N; no deflection value is published.

attempts.query: YOELEO Altera G21 independent review stiffness ride
attempts.note: The feature discusses stability and comfort but is disclosed paid promotion and provides no comparative stiffness measurement.

notes: The fatigue protocol is useful manufacturer evidence but is not presented as an independent stiffness score.
